summary: Add exact provider-neutral forecast, stock projection and guarded replenishment planning foundation with tenant-scoped persistence.

impacts.evidence: All new planning tables carry organization/workspace keys and forced RLS policies.
Planning persistence stores bounded digests and reason text, not raw provider payloads or credentials.
This foundation adds no public HTTP operation; REST/OpenAPI remains a separately gated follow-up slice.
No canonical event payload is changed; durable EventBus triggers remain a separately gated worker slice.
No connector SDK interface or provider capability contract is changed by the provider-neutral planning model.
Migration 32 is additive, transactional, checksummed and backup-gated.
Exact quantities, bounded text, tenant RLS and fail-closed auto-submit policy are enforced.
The model only emits proposed/draft decisions; procurement approval remains authoritative.
Runs retain algorithm/input digests and recommendation history is append-only.
Run digests, versioned policies and idempotent purchase-plan keys are persisted.
This foundation makes no remote webhook or egress call and persists no provider response.
Run quality, freshness, coverage and risk indexes provide bounded signals for the later worker SLO gate.
The additive schema and advisory-only mode can be disabled without rewriting inventory or procurement facts.
Deterministic unit tests cover digest ordering, return netting, forecasts, shortfall and pack rounding.
